games.title: Arena Shooter
games.tag: online multiplayer · first person · up to 8
games.desc: First-person drop-in shooter on an authored map, in three modes picked per lobby: free for all (first to 20 frags), team deathmatch (blue against red, no friendly fire, team spawns, first team to 30) and king of the hill (the spot under the king block; alone on it earns a point a second, contested earns nothing, first to 60). Every round ends, names its winner and restarts after a 10 s pause with every score reset and every block re-armed. WASD + mouse look, Space jump, RMB aim, R reload, Shift sprint, C crouch — crouching also shrinks your hitbox. Q raises a Roman scutum that sends a bullet back at the shooter and detonates a rocket; E cuts with the Murasama, kills outright and goes straight through a raised shield. Headshots kill outright too, so aim high. v18 is the weapons update: seven guns, each a different bullet — the sidearm you spawn with, the Vityaz SMG, the AK-47, the heavy revolver whose slug drops, a sniper that pierces one body, and the RPG-7 with a 3 m splash that hurts you too — and you get them by jumping so your head hits a ? block from below, Mario-style; a random gun pops out with one magazine and one reserve, no refills, and when it runs dry the sidearm is back. Two maps, picked per lobby: Freight Yard, a rail yard at golden hour with two trains of containers, an open yard, a loading dock under the king block, and backlots to spawn in; and Trench City, the fought-over European square, its four pads replaced by four ? blocks at the tunnel mouths, so the blocks are the one reward on both maps. v20 is the realism pass: every round flies at its gun's real muzzle velocity and stops at the first thing on its path, you see it as a tracer with an impact that matches the material it hit, and you hear a layered gunshot delayed and panned by distance, a crack when a round passes within three metres, impacts, casings and per-gun reloads. Gamepad play with per-gun rumble on Chromium; keyboard and mouse everywhere. Fullscreen: F11 on the native client, F or the button on the page.

games.title: Fire Racer
games.desc: Arcade racing through a gothic castle bailey — a 920 m circuit with a main straight, a long sweeper, a fountain chicane and a hairpin. WASD to drive, Space for the handbrake to break traction and drift, Shift to spend one of three boost charges. Practice alone, or open a lobby and race other people on an authoritative server.

versions.note: castle circuit, drift + boost, online lobbies

games.title: Four Kings
games.tag: online, turn based, 2-4 players, 15 s turns
games.desc: Four-corner chess on a 10x10 board: king, queen, two rooks, two bishops, a knight and seven pawns per corner, plus two new legends. The Joker teleports between mirror tiles, is placed anywhere every fifth turn, and captures on exactly one tile, its front-left. The Hero sleeps in the corner until it trades places with one of your pawns and wakes as a rook-plus-knight. Pawns march forward or left and capture on three diagonals, so a corner formation is never a wall. One action per 15-second turn, three timeouts and you are out, last king standing wins. Click a piece, click a highlighted target; Esc clears. Swap your legend and epic cards within their class before the game starts.

versions.note: first build: within-class card swap, 15 s turns

games.title: what is this?
games.tag: local diagnostic · browser + hardware · optional upload
games.desc: A playful, staged answer to a practical question: what kind of machine and browser is this? Runs fixed wasm CPU and timing kernels, records floating-point and feature fingerprints, and keeps going when a probe is unavailable. The complete JSON report can stay on your device; sending it to the Ember server is a separate, explicit choice.

versions.note: diagnostic suite + optional report submission
